name: Pushinator
author: wpappricos

sections.description:
Pushinator allows you to receive instant push notifications on your iPhone or Android device when important events happen on your WordPress site.

Features

  • WordPress Events: Get notified about new posts, pages, comments, user registrations, login attempts, and system updates
  • WooCommerce Support: Receive alerts for new orders, order status changes, low stock, out of stock, new customers, and product reviews
  • Multiple Channels: Create different channels for different types of notifications
  • Acknowledgment Support: Require confirmation that notifications were received (paid plans)
  • Detailed Logs: Track all sent notifications with success/failure status
  • Easy Setup: Simple configuration with API token

Supported WordPress Events

  • New post/page published
  • Post updated or deleted
  • Draft published, pending post approved
  • New comments, comment approved/spam/trashed
  • User registration, login, failed login attempts
  • User role changes, password resets
  • WordPress/plugin/theme updates
  • Theme changes

Supported WooCommerce Events

  • New orders
  • Order status changes (pending, processing, completed, cancelled, refunded, failed, on-hold)
  • Low stock and out of stock alerts
  • Product backorders
  • New customer registrations
  • Customer address updates
  • New product reviews

How It Works

  1. Create a channel at Pushinator Console
  2. Install the Pushinator app on your mobile device
  3. Scan the channel QR code to subscribe
  4. Configure which WordPress events should trigger notifications
  5. Receive instant push notifications on your phone

External Service

This plugin connects to the Pushinator API (https://api.pushinator.com) to send push notifications to your mobile devices.

  • Service Website: https://pushinator.com
  • Terms of Service: https://pushinator.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://pushinator.com/privacy

Data sent to the service includes:
* Your API token for authentication
* Channel ID for routing notifications
* Notification message content

No personal user data from your WordPress site is shared without your explicit configuration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pushinator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Pushinator > Settings and enter your API token
  4. Go to Pushinator > Channels and add your first channel
  5. Select the events you want to receive notifications for

Getting Your API Token

  1. Sign up at Pushinator Console
  2. Create a new channel
  3. Copy your API token from the dashboard
  4. Paste it in the plugin settings

Mobile Apps

Download the Pushinator app to receive notifications:

  • App Store (iPhone/iPad)
  • Google Play (Android)
sections.faq:
Do I need a Pushinator account?

Yes, you need a free account at pushinator.com to get your API token and create channels.

Is WooCommerce required?

No, WooCommerce is optional. The plugin works with standard WordPress events. WooCommerce events are only available if WooCommerce is installed and active.

Can I send notifications to multiple devices?

Yes, multiple users can subscribe to the same channel by scanning the QR code. All subscribers will receive notifications.

What is the Acknowledgment feature?

When enabled, notifications will require the recipient to confirm they received the message. This feature is available on paid Pushinator plans.

Are there any limits on notifications?

The free Pushinator plan includes a limited number of notifications per month. Check pushinator.com for current plan details.

Can I customize notification messages?

Currently, notification messages are automatically generated based on the event type. Custom message templates may be added in future versions.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all communication with the Pushinator API uses HTTPS encryption. Your API token is stored securely in the WordPress database.

  • Support for WooCommerce events (orders, products, customers, reviews)
  • Channel management with event selection
  • Notification logging with status tracking
  • Test notification feature
  • Acknowledgment support for paid plans
